data.name: Land Farm
data.detailed_description:
🚜 Agroempire: From Seed to Corporation

Dive into a world of limitless agricultural possibilities!

This is not just a game about tractors and fields. It’s a deep economic sandbox where you start with a dream, a couple of seed packets, and a small plot of land. Your path to prosperity begins here. The capital you accumulate will let you buy up new plots, expanding your holdings to the scale of a true agroempire. Every well-thought-out decision brings a steady income.

🌾 Full Agricultural Cycle

Every stage matters: from plowing and sowing to harvesting. Watch the growth phases change – from tender sprouts to a golden field – and make decisions in time.

But crop farming is only the beginning. Get into animal husbandry: raise chickens, pigs, and cattle. Care for them, feed them, and obtain meat, milk, wool, and other valuable resources. Your farm must live and breathe!

🌲 Resource Gathering and Logging

The boundaries of your world aren't dictated by beds and fields. Head into the vast forests to fell trees for construction materials, gather wild berries and mushrooms, or hunt game. The forest is a treasure trove of resources that will never let you get bored and will always supply raw materials for production.

🏭 Processing and Manufacturing

Raw materials are only half the battle. Build workshops, purchase machinery, and launch conveyor belts. But true mastery is revealed in the recipes! You'll have to discover and study unique combinations on your own to create high-value-added products. Turn grain into flour, milk into cheese, and wood into furniture.

💰 Economy and Trade

Different locations have different demand for goods. Handle the logistics: somewhere flour is desperately needed, and somewhere they’re willing to overpay for meat. Study the demand map, plot profitable routes, and sell your goods where they’re ready to pay a truly high price.

🏠 Construction and Expansion

Build not just boxes, but architectural masterpieces. Create a unique look for your agro-complex – from a cozy mill to huge concrete elevators. Only here do you decide what your business looks like. Turn a backwater hamlet into a flourishing town.

The time has come not just to work the land, but to rule it. Build, produce, trade, and become a legend of agriculture!

Minimum:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 700 series or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
